usedFor: manyreach runs cold outreach, and “Create or Update Prospect” adds a prospect and can add them to a campaign.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create or Update Prospect” in manyreach
bestTemplate.why: A prospect is created or updated by email, so repeat contacts do not become duplicates.

watchOut: “Delete Prospect” permanently deletes a prospect by ID or email, so test it before you rely on it.
